# Municipal Ordinance No. 11, Series of 2004

**Ordinance regarding salaries, wages, and benefits for Pitogo Municipal Ice Plant employees.**

## Summary

This ordinance provides for the salaries, wages, and benefits of three employees of the Pitogo Municipal Ice Plant (PMIP), as well as funds for its maintenance and operation. It defines key terms related to the ice plant and its employees, fixes the salaries/wages of PMIP personnel, and specifies working days. The ordinance also includes repealing and effectivity clauses.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section I - Definition of Terms:** Defines "PITOGO MUNICIPAL ICE PLANT (PMIP)", "PITOGO MUNICIPAL ICE PLANT EMPLOYEES", "SALARIES/WAGES", "BENEFITS", and "FUNDS FOR MAINTENANCE AND OPERATION".
2.  **Section II - Fixing the salaries/wages of PMIP personnel:** Sets the salaries/wages of each personnel/worker at no more than ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY PESOS (P= 150.00) a day including Saturday and Sunday.
3.  **Section III - Working Days:** Specifies that PMIP employees shall work on a day-to-day basis on an 8-hour day with shifting of their works and shall be under the Office of the Municipal Agriculture.
4.  **Section IV - Repealing Clause:** Any provision of existing municipal ordinance inconsistent herewith is hereby deemed repealed.
5.  **Section V - .** Should any provision of this ordinance thereafter declared illegal or unconstitutional the same shall not affect all other provisions, which shall remain enforceable.
6.  **Section VI - Effectivity Clause:** This ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its approval and only until the last day of December [[2004]].
